Character-specific identity lock:
Sakurapon is a small pink cherry-blossom spirit: its ENTIRE head/body is one broad flattened pink blossom-shaped volume with the same big rounded petal lobes and notches as the sprite. The irregular petal perimeter is its silhouette, NOT a round apple with flowers attached, not a pink furry animal. One small simple green leaf protrudes from the top-center. Exactly TWO short dark brown twig-like legs/feet extend below. No arms, no nose, no stem trunk, no flower crown.
